title: 721. Subarray Product Less Than K

examples.explanation: Eight windows qualify: the four singles plus [10,5], [5,2], [2,6] and [5,2,6].
All values are positive, so no product can fall below 0.
Every one of the six windows multiplies to 1.

hints: All numbers are positive, so extending a window only grows its product and shrinking only lowers it.
Maintain a sliding window product; when it reaches k, move the left edge until it fits again.
Each right endpoint contributes (right - left + 1) new valid windows.
